notes: Path, selector and numeric animation facts only; no original asset bytes or scene source.
Unregistered triggers and unavailable animations preserve the current visible animation.
The fixed-slot clip accompanying hold_current is a storage placeholder and must not be played.
Random skin groups retain duplicate choices and are combined in declaration order.
Crusher and Rocket are actors on one shared KaiserCrab background skeleton; their invisible creature nodes do not render separate sprites.
Constraint entries are setup facts; per-clip timeline_types separately identifies animated constraints.
Skeleton and atlas bytes, runtime binary and original scene source are private inputs and are not distributed.
